title: Voltra: choose the visual world
question: The roll picked 'Event Credential'. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Event Credential
options.lineage: LAN event lanyard passes, wristbands and tear-off match tickets
options.thesis: Every page is a pass you would wear at a Voltra LAN: badges, tiers, stubs, scans.
options.viewport: A giant ALL ACCESS credential hangs from a lanyard strap that drops from the top edge and swings with the cursor; headline and Get your pass action sit beside it.
options.risk: If the badge grammar is applied timidly it reads as a gimmick card on a plain page.

raised.raise: Restricted inks: the whole site prints in four tier inks plus laminate white and arena black, nothing else.
Decisive beat: the holographic foil appears once per page, on the one element that matters most.
Duotone photos: every Unsplash photo is printed in arena black plus one tier ink, like a badge photo.
Match state is line form, not colour: live solid, upcoming dashed, finished struck through.
Pass lifecycle states: issued, scanned, void, each a physical mark on the badge rather than a toast.

options.label: Broadcast Package
options.lineage: esports stream overlays: scorebugs, lower thirds, caster tickers
options.thesis: The site runs like a live stream graphics package, every section a broadcast slate.
options.viewport: A full-bleed match slate with a scorebug, team names and a LIVE ticker crawling along the bottom.
options.risk: Familiar: this is close to where most esports sites already land.

options.label: Departure Board
options.thesis: Tournaments and matches flip in like departures on a station board.
options.viewport: A giant flap board listing next matches; rows clack into place on load.
options.case: Very clear for schedules and point tables; weaker for players and shop.
options.risk: Strong on the tournaments page, thin everywhere else.

options.label: Kiosk Print
options.lineage: state kiosk printed goods in three inks
options.thesis: Merch and matches as matchbox labels in three permitted inks.
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of product cells, no photography.
options.case: Esports fans and clients do not recognise this world.
options.risk: Reads as an art project, not an esports brand.

options.label: Manga Page
options.thesis: Matches told as manga panels with speed lines.
options.viewport: A panel grid with the next match as the decisive black panel.
options.case: Gamers like the vibe, but tournaments, shop and stats lose clarity.
options.risk: Shop and point table fight the panel grammar.

options.label: Glaze Shelf
options.thesis: Results as glaze running down a shelf.
options.viewport: A shelf of samples with glaze runs.
options.case: No link to esports for either audience.

options.label: Indoor Sun
options.thesis: One amber hall, players as silhouettes.
options.viewport: A half sun on the far wall with silhouettes.
options.case: Atmospheric but hides the tournaments and shop.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: A single rail with ticks for each page.
options.case: Too abstract for fans and clients.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Classic esports theme: near-black, one neon accent, angled buttons, glow.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero photo, giant uppercase headline, two angled neon buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every esports template, including the one you showed me.
